reviews.comment: The only reason why this professor is rated low is because engineers in the lower level classes have 2 brain cells and cant even compute a simple integral or derivative which any rational human being can. If you want to learn 409 or any class stress free, then take this class!

This is the best prof I have had during college. He is so caring about his students and truly wants them to do well. He gives awesome reviews before the exam, making an otherwise confusing course approachable and easy to understand. Also, he moved the HW due on Thanksgiving to a week later. Don't listen to the negative reviews. He is the best.

Dr. Liu was okay for the first few weeks while the material was easy, but as the material increased in difficulty, his ability to teach it declined. The HW had questions that weren't covered during lecture, and he even made a homework assignment due on Thanksgiving day. His tests are frustrating as his true/false questions are written to trick you.

Do not take this professor! Professor Liu did not help me learn at all in Math 171, and he didn't even teach us the proper concepts needed for Math 172. I stressed so much about this class, and he didn't even want to help outside of class. He ended up curving grades significantly because the average for the final was a 48%. Do not take the risk!
Sped through important concepts, tests got crazy hard towards the end, but ended up curving the final. If you haven't taken calc before, then wouldn't recommend taking this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were unclear and confusing, tests were unreasonably hard and he does not curve. I had to buy an online calculus course to supplement the unhelpful lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's not amazing by any means. His lectures were ok at first but later down the road a lot of things didn't make sense. His notes were pulled from other sites and he didn't know how to explain them. After the first test, his last two exams were insanely hard. Material was not fun and I now have a poor foundation in diff eq. Pls choose another prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His first test was very easy and he seemed like he was on our side. Then the second test and the final exam were incredibly hard. He didn't really know how to explain some of the material covered after the first test. His notes were basically from problems on other sites (paul's online notes, khan academy, the book, etc.). I don't recommend him.

Liu is an amazing teacher. Not only does he really care about teaching the material (summarizes txbk well), he cares about the students grades just as much. He prepares us extremely well for the tests + the grading on homework is lenient. He takes late grades with only a 20 point deduction (even tho I was a month late on one assignment). (curves!)

He's ok. He was not bad at first. The first exam was easy but everything after that was really hard. He said the final was going to be easy but I was bawling during that exam. I wish he could make his exams weighted a little less because if you blow one exam, it's pretty hard to come back up. Overall, it was a fairly difficult class for me.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Doesn't offer too much homework, which sounds nice but is actually detrimental to us. Thus, you must have your own initiative to find practice problems on your own, which are hard to find because textbook problems are more confusing and harder than his exam problems. He does curve a lot and does try to go easy.2 midterms 20% each and final 40%.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy
